crossRefs.note: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of Yahweh.
He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.
Yahweh is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.
Blessed are you, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.
Teach me your way, Yahweh. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.
Many peoples shall go and say, “Come, let’s go up to the mountain of Yahweh, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he…
Yahweh, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “I am Yahweh your God, who teaches you to profit, who leads you by…
Oh that you had listened to my commandments! Then your peace would have been like a river and your righteousness like…
Take my yoke upon you, and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

translations.web: The earth is full of your loving kindness, Yahweh. Teach me your statutes.
translations.bsb: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
translations.kjv: The earth, O LORD, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.
translations.asv: The earth, O Jehovah, is full of thy lovingkindness: Teach me thy statutes.
